tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 1st house: autonomy and the disowned self activate through identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 1st house can activate the disowned, uncompromising self through identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly. For roughly nine months, this transit may expose where shame, control, compliance, or refusal has gathered around these topics. You are uncompromising about who you are; you refuse to be told how to be, and it shows on sight. Strongly colors the whole personality; intense drives that often sit hidden in the unconscious. The work is to understand and own the energy rather than be unconsciously run by it.
business: The disowned self activates through identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly. A magnetic, undeniable presence when owned.
shadow: A confrontational identity, or hiding the raw self behind a guarded front.
advice: Reclaim autonomy in the 1st house without letting reaction make the decision for you. Work with identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly directly and consciously.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
